title: Trust, But Verify: Human-in-the-Loop for Agents That Actually Matter
description: AI agents are getting good at taking action. The hard part isn't making them capable, it's knowing when to make them stop. In this talk we'll walk through the full spectrum of human-in-the-loop patterns, from lightweight inline confirmations to out-of-band permission gates to handing your agent a wallet with real money in it and more. Each pattern fits a different level of consequence, and knowing which to reach for is what separates demo agents from production ones. title: The Past Didn't Go Anywhere: Fundamentals > AI
description: For decades, our industry has predicted that the next wave of technology would replace software developers. From COBOL to the dot-com boom, DevOps, and now AI, each shift has promised to fundamentally change our profession. Yet developers are still here. The difference is that every wave has demanded new skills, not fewer developers. As AI continues to reshape software engineering, one thing has become increasingly clear: the developers who thrive will be the ones who understand the fundamentals. title: Knowledge Graphs: The Memory Your Data Team Doesn't Have (Yet)
description: Most teams relearn the same lessons over and over. Every investigation ends in a chat window or a one off notebook, and the hard won context evaporates the moment it closes. Knowledge Graphs turn an organization's scattered, hard-won expertise into a durable, machine-readable asset that both people and AI agents can use; continuously mined, source-attributed, and self-improving. Every answer you find once, you never have to find again. Learn once. Know forever. Join Everette Petsinger, Data Scientist at John Deere, to see how it works and how your life will be changed forever.
